roles.title: Product and domain owner
responsibilities: Confirm the problem boundary, risk tolerance, and acceptance outcomes.
Make business decisions that cannot be inferred from repository evidence.
deliverables: A confirmed business scope and decision record.
Acceptance criteria for the next delivery slice.

roles.title: Technical delivery owner
responsibilities: Own module boundaries, delivery sequencing, and cross-stack integration decisions.
Keep implementation choices traceable to repository evidence and confirmed business constraints.
deliverables: A verification strategy for each delivery slice.

roles.title: Frontend delivery owner
responsibilities: Own user-facing module boundaries, accessibility, and client contract integration.
Keep UI state and data-fetching behavior independently testable.
deliverables: A component and route ownership map.
Client-side verification for critical user flows.

roles.title: Backend, API, and data owner
responsibilities: Own service-module boundaries, API contracts, data invariants, and idempotent delivery behavior.
Define transaction and failure-handling ownership for backend changes.
deliverables: Failure and duplicate-delivery verification for critical flows.

roles.title: Quality and release reviewer
responsibilities: Own independent acceptance evidence, negative cases, and release-readiness review.
Report remaining verification gaps without changing the delivery scope.
deliverables: Independent review records for high-risk changes.

roles.title: Realtime and media reliability owner
responsibilities: Own realtime event compatibility, media-token boundaries, and recovery behavior when these capabilities are in scope.
Define observability and load-test criteria before production realtime delivery.

roles.title: Security and integrity reviewer
responsibilities: Independently review authorization boundaries, tamper resistance, replay protection, and sensitive-data handling that the owner has confirmed.
Escalate legal, privacy, or regulated-industry questions to qualified specialists instead of declaring compliance.
deliverables: Threat-model and negative-path review evidence for confirmed high-risk flows.
A record of unresolved security and compliance questions.

roles.title: Platform and operations owner
responsibilities: Own deployment safety, observability, incident response, and operational recovery criteria for a confirmed operating service.
Keep production readiness distinct from feature implementation.
deliverables: Service-level objectives confirmed by the product owner.
